title: Titanium Chainring Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Chainring Bolt because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Chainring fixing bolt set (M6). This rationale is driven by chainring fixing bolt set (m6) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for drivetrain hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with 0.5mm corner radius
Go/No-Go ring gauging with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for chainring fixing bolt application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for chainring fixing bolt performance

faq.q: How much weight savings does Titanium Chainring Bolt offer versus steel or aluminum?
faq.a: Titanium Chainring Bolt fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides a 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130 chromoly steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at the same strength. Compared to 6061-T6 aluminum, titanium's 3× higher yield strength (830 vs 275 MPa) allows 50-60% thinner walls, resulting in a net weight comparable to aluminum with 4× better fatigue life — critical for chainring fixing bolt.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Chainring Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Chainring Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Chainring Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Chainring Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for chainring fixing bolt.
